name: CedCommerce Connector for Miravia
author: cedcommerce

sections.description:
Expand your eCommerce horizons and sell on Miravia effortlessly with the WooCommerce Miravia Marketplace Plugin by CedCommerce. This powerful WooCommerce Miravia plugin bridges the gap between your store and Miravia, ensuring seamless product syncing, real-time inventory updates, and streamlined order management—all from a single dashboard.

Automate bulk uploads, customize listings with ease, and keep your catalog optimized without the manual hassle. Designed for efficiency and growth, this WooCommerce Miravia plugin empowers sellers to scale faster, maximize sales, and establish a strong presence in one of Europe’s fastest-growing marketplaces.

Main features

  • Effortless Bulk Uploads
    Upload your entire product catalog to Miravia with just a few clicks. Ensure accuracy and efficiency while saving time so you can focus on scaling your business.

  • Automated Inventory Management
    Keep your stock levels synchronized in near real-time across Miravia and your WooCommerce store. Avoid overselling with regular updates and low-stock notifications.

  • Simplified Product Listing
    List your products on Miravia seamlessly while maintaining consistency across your catalog. Reduce errors and expand your reach to a wider customer base.

  • Advanced Product Profiling
    Group products into customized profiles and define attributes like category, pricing, or stock levels. Easily apply bulk actions, ensuring faster and more accurate uploads to Miravia.

  • Near Real-Time Synchronization
    Ensure product prices and inventory levels are always up to date across Miravia and your eCommerce store with instant updates, preventing listing discrepancies.

  • Streamlined Order Management
    Manage all Miravia orders from a single, intuitive dashboard. Improve efficiency, reduce manual errors, and deliver a seamless shopping experience to your customers.

External API

This plugin utilizes external APIs (https://app-backend.cifapps.com/ and https://api-backend.cifapps.com/ ) to facilitate seamless integration with Miravia. These APIs enable advanced functionalities such as product listing management and order synchronization. For more information about the API, please visit Cedcommerce Privacy Policy Page (https://cedcommerce.com/privacy-policy).
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of CedCommerce Connector for Miravia, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field type “CedCommerce Connector for Miravia” and click Search Plugins. Once you’ve found our CedCommerce Connector for Miravia plugin you can view details about it such as the point release, rating and description. Most importantly of course, you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

The manual installation method involves downloading our CedCommerce Connector for Miravia and uploading it to your webserver via your favourite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here.
sections.faq:
How do I upload products to Miravia?

Navigate to the ‘Product’ section and follow the guided steps to upload your products to Miravia.

How can I receive order notifications?

Ensure your notification preferences are configured in the ‘Activities Notification’ section to receive timely updates.
